title: Render actionable status and doctor reports

## Required Skills
godex:godex-go-backend

Add focused cmd/smt renderers using standard-library tabular formatting and plain OK/WARN/ERROR labels with no mandatory ANSI styling. Status renders an overall summary, repository/path/Git/branch/hook table, profiles, contract counts, then deduplicated next steps. Doctor groups repositories, hooks, tools, and credentials, then prints only actionable remediation. Missing hooks warn and point to smt hooks install; custom hooks explain the refusal policy. Preserve stdout/stderr separation, deterministic order, secret redaction, status exit 0 for findings, and doctor error-based exit behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Clean output is aligned and concise; dirty, detached, uninitialized, missing/custom-hook, missing-tool/token, contract-warning, contract-error, and diagnostic-error fixtures show accurate labels and aggregated remediation; help explains Git, hook, profile, and contract terminology; status --json remains semantically compatible; doctor never prints token values or private errors; exit codes and redirected output remain stable; focused renderer and command tests pass.
